title: FRONT CARPETS & INSULATORS
summary: Front (passenger compartment) carpet set and the tunnel insulators (sound/heat pads under the carpet on the front, center and rear transmission tunnel), all models. The carpet edges are held by push-in fasteners at the top of the kick panel/toe board area and glued with 51d adhesive along the door sill under the sill trim plate; the front tunnel insulator differs between coupe (19437) and convertible (19467).

parts.name: CHART-FRT CARPET ASM.

materials.where: carpet [4] edge at the door sill, under the sill trim plate on the underbody

fastening.to: body at the upper edge of the carpet in the footwell (kick panel / toe board)
fastening.note: Fastener [1] pushes in from the carpet face through holes along the top edge of the front carpet [4]; several holes shown along that edge.
Carpet edge wraps over the sill flange and is glued with 51d adhesive; the sill trim plate goes over it.
